name: Alica Schmidt career
content: Alica Schmidt's career highlights: German 400m sprinter; competed at the Tokyo 2020 and Paris 2024 Olympics; European U20 Championships 4x400m relay silver medalist; Transitioned from 400m to 800m after the Paris Games in search of a new challenge

name: Alica Schmidt personal
content: About Alica Schmidt: Born November 8, 1998, in Worms, Germany. The media dubbed her 'the world's hottest athlete' — a title she openly rejects. Hugo Boss ambassador; posts contrasting 'girly girl' and 'bro' mode gym content.

name: Alica Schmidt quotes
content: Things Alica Schmidt has said: Sport clearly comes first. | The best thing about being an athlete is that you always have the choice to ignore every important task, train for five hours instead, and it still feels like a productive day.

name: Alica Schmidt voice
content: Alica Schmidt's speaking style: Humble, earnest and dryly funny on social media. Talks about training with self-deprecating humor while insisting sport comes first.
